 Order

The petitioner seeks for the following relief:
Writ of Certiorari to call for the records relating to the proceedings, dated 16.05.2022, in R.No.Case No.104/2021 passed by the 1st respondent under the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standards (Food Safety Standard and food additive) Regulations, 2011, and quash the same in so far as it relates to the levy of penalty on the petitioner.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Food Safety Standard and food additive) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2.As against the impugned order, a statutory appeal lies under Section 70 of Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006.
The petitioner has been bona fidely pursuing the remedy before this Court from 2022 onwards.
3.The issues raised by Mr.R.Saravana Kumar for the petitioner are disputed questions of fact.
Hence, I am not inclined to go into the merits of the Writ Petition.
Liberty is granted to the Writ Petitioner to prefer an appeal as against the impugned order within 30 days from today.

In the event of any appeal is filed within the said period, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
29/04/2025 02:52:48 pm ) delay, that had occasioned from the date of this order till the date of filing of the appeal, shall be deemed to have been condoned.
In other words, the appellate Tribunal shall entertain the appeal, if it is filed within the period of 30 days, without insisting an application to condone the delay.
The Writ Petition is dismissed accordingly.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
